mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, connection_id, title, topic, audience, style, output_format, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM content_project WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, workspace_id, connection_id, title, topic, audience, style, output_format, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM content_project WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE content_project SET connection_id = #{project.connectionId}, title = #{project.title}, topic = #{project.topic}, audience = #{project.audience}, style = #{project.style}, output_format = #{project.outputFormat}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{project.updatedAt} WHERE id = #{project.id} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'ACTIVE') AND version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS material_id, m.content_project_id, m.source_type, m.source_id, m.relation_type, m.sort_order, CASE WHEN m.source_type = 'DOCUMENT' THEN d.name WHEN m.source_type = 'ARTIFACT' THEN a.title ELSE NULL END AS source_title, m.created_at AS material_created_at FROM content_project_material m LEFT JOIN document d ON m.source_type = 'DOCUMENT' AND d.id = m.source_id LEFT JOIN artifact a ON m.source_type = 'ARTIFACT' AND a.id = m.source_id WHERE m.content_project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY m.sort_order ASC, m.id ASC

SELECT id AS material_id, content_project_id, source_type, source_id, relation_type, sort_order, NULL AS source_title, created_at AS material_created_at FROM content_project_material WHERE content_project_id = #{projectId} AND id = #{materialId} FOR UPDATE
